answer: Before a newcomer can trade, it must find a haven: two established sponsors vouch for it, each staking their standing. The newcomer then spends a week in a trial, finishing three signed jobs under a gale of copy checks. A rotating panel checks signatures and a whisper of prior conduct within 48 hours; a copied job or a second application from the same device voids the entry, burns the stake, and bars all three for a cycle. One honest newcomer costs two sponsors a week; a thousand fakes need two thousand sponsors ready to burn their standing.
